capabilities: Create, start and finish a task with one Toggle Task command
Insert today's due routines from routine notes into daily notes
Show tasks and a read-only timeline in a sidebar pane
Sum estimates and project a finish time in the status bar
disambiguation: Not an audio or screen recorder; it writes task start and finish times into Markdown checkbox lines.
extras: Most specification files live in a docs/ folder and are written in Japanese; SRS growth is off by default and marked experimental. Timers, calendar integration, statistics and dashboards are listed as out of scope.
motivation: The author wanted writing tasks down in Markdown to feel cheap and natural, so attention goes to recording rather than learning the tool.
problem: Obsidian checkboxes hold no start or finish times, so there is no plain-text record of how long tasks actually took.

relations.evidence: Install and enable the BRAT community plugin
the same idea as Anki's handling of overdue cards

summary: Markdown task recorder that stamps start and finish times on checkbox lines, with routines, a summary pane and a timeline.
